book.title: Cau amsǝban a nê mala LUKA

content: Gūliarǝu mala ɓwamǝgule soje
Lang Yesu malǝna banggi aɓwana amǝnia yì acau ka, pǝlǝa kutio o a Kapanahum.
Aɓa mǝnia yì la ka guro mala ɓe ɓwamǝgule soje mala amǝ Roma, mǝnana earkiyi ace raka, nongkwánó yi bwal kun-lú.
Sǝ lang ɓwamǝgule soje man ok ce Yesu, túr aɓwana-mǝgule mala amǝ Yahudi a baní, ɓǝà zǝmbi wi ɓǝ̀ yiu ɓǝ̀ yi twali guro male ban rǝkwana.
À yiu a ban Yesu à yì zǝmbi wi nǝ ɓabumia mwashat ama, <<Mǝnia yì ɓwa ka ɓoaro wu bwalì wi kàm!
Yì ka, kǝ earce nzali ma'sǝm, ɗǝm ngga ɓakka sǝm Ndakpapi.>>

Yesu pǝlǝa bwal njargula aban ká andǝia. Gbàshìnà ban ɓala ka, ɓwamǝgule soje man túr agyajam male ɓǝà ne Yesu ama, <<Mǝtalabangŋo, kǝa pè ɓamuro tanni ɗang, acemǝnana ǝn kārǝa wu kutio a ɓala mem ɗàng.
Sǝ ǝn sǝni ka ǝn kārǝa mǝ nǝ ká a bano ɗàng. Bangcau àkǝ̀ ban mǝnana a ndakam ngga, sǝ guro mem nǝ̀ kum rǝcandǝa.

Acemǝnana mim nǝ ɓamúràm ngga, mǝ nda aɓata ɓwa, nǝ asoje a ɓatam. Ɓǝ̀ ǝn ne man ama, <O> ka, nǝ̀ ká, sǝ ɓǝ̀ ǝn ne ɓwa mǝno ama, <Yiu> ka, nǝ̀ yiu gbal. Ɓǝ̀ ǝn ne guro mem ama, <Pak mǝnia ka> nǝ̀ pè.>>
Lang Yesu ok man yì cau ka, ndali kǝ̀rkǝ́r, pǝlǝ rǝì aban ɓwabundǝa mǝnana à kǝ yiu atè ka, nea wia ama,

content.text: <<Ən nggǝ na wun, ǝn malaká kum gūliarǝu mǝgule ulang man aɓa nzali Isǝrayila ɗang!>>

content: Lang aɓwana mǝnana à túriá à nyarǝna a ɓala ka, à kya kum guro man, rǝì bǎng.
Yesu loasǝ lú-muna mala mā-lú
A nzǝmi bǝti ka, Yesu o a la mǝnana à tunǝki ama Nayi ka. Alaggana male andǝ aɓwabundǝa kǝ̀rkǝ́r o atè.

Lang gbàshìnà kun la ka, à je andǝ aɓea ɓwana mǝnana à twalǝna lú-mǝlagga à nǝ̀ nggǝ purni ka. Yì lú ka ndà kǝ̀ muna-ɓwabura mwashat a bu nggè. Sǝ nggè ka mā-lú na. Ɓwabunda pas mǝnana a le ka à puro atè.
Lang Mǝtalabangŋo sǝn ɓwama man ngga, mǝsǝswatǝr male bwali, pǝlǝa ne wi ama,

content.text: <<Ce a ɓua ɗang!>>

content: Pǝlǝa kutio tsǝk buì arǝ kal-lú. Amǝ twal lú pǝlǝa à cam gǝs. Sǝ Yesu na ama,

content.text: <<Lagga, ǝn nggǝ no ama wu lo!>>

content: Lú kara lo dum nǝ do, tita nacau, pǝlǝa Yesu nyesǝi pe nggè.
Ko yan ngga gir nî karmuri, pǝlǝa à ɓwangsǝ Ɓakuli, à kǝ na ama, <<Ɓè mǝɓangnǝa mǝgule pusǝna rǝì aban sǝm. Ɓakuli yina ace amsǝ aɓwana male!>>
Cau mala gir mǝnia Yesu pe ka, akiban aɓa nzali Yahudi andǝ acili alá mǝnana à kàrì banì ka.
Yohana Mǝbatisǝma turban atà Yesu
Alaggana mala Yohana yi banggi wi agir mǝnana kat Yesu pea ka. Pǝlǝa Yohana tunǝ aɓwana ɓari ateà,
sǝ tasǝia aban Mǝtalabangŋo ɓǝa kya ɗì ama, <<A nda Kǝrǝsti Mǝ'amsǝban, mǝnana sǝm nggǝ kundǝ ka le, ko ɓǝ̀ sǝm kundǝ ɓeɓwa ɗàng?>>
Lang aɓwana man yina aban Yesu ka, à yì na ama, <<Yohana Mǝbatisǝma túr sǝm a bano, ɓǝ̀ sǝm yì ɗio ama, <A nda Kǝrǝsti Mǝ'amsǝban mǝnana sǝm nggǝ kundǝ ka le, ko ɓǝ̀ sǝm kundǝ ɓeɓwa ɗàng?> >>
Àkǝ̀ banì Yesu twalia aɓwana pas ban akwánó andǝ arǝpangŋa malea, pusǝki akukwar arǝ aɓwana, sǝ mǝn mǝsǝ ante.
Pǝlǝa ne aɓwana mǝnana Yohana túriá ka ama,

content.text: <<Wu nyare wu kya banggi Yohana agir mǝnana wu sǝn andǝ mǝnana wu ok ka. Ante kǝ sǝnban, aman à gbakǝri a kusǝia ka à lo à kǝ gya, amǝkwánó-dakali ka à kǝ twalia wia ban dakali malea, amǝkir'ara kǝ okban, à kǝ loasǝ alú, sǝ Cau Amsǝban ngga à kǝ hamnǝi a ban amǝ'tǝ̀r.
Ɓwa mǝnana makgìr cau mem raka ndanǝ tsǝkbu mala Ɓakuli!>>

content: Anzǝm o mala aɓwana mǝnana Yohana túriá ka, Yesu tita nea ɓwapǝndǝa acau amur Yohana ama,

content.text: <<Lang wu puro wu wari a ban Yohana aɓa pǝɗanban a njenza ka, mana gir nì nda wu waria sǝne? Ndǝrdangŋa mǝnana gung kǝ dǝurǝki ka nda le? Awo!
Sǝ ɓǝ̀ nda raka, mana wu waria sǝne? Ɓè ɓwa na mǝnana makki adaura mǝɓoarne arǝì ka le? Awo! Aɓwana mǝnana à makkiyi adaura mǝɓoarne sǝ à nda aɓa banɓoarna mala kume ka, à nda malea a palta.
Sǝ mana wu waria sǝne? Mǝɓangnǝa mala Ɓakuli na le? E, ǝn nggǝ na wun, yì ka, kútì mǝɓangnǝa mala Ɓakuli.
Yohana nda ɓwa mǝnana Malǝmce bangcau amurí ama:
<< <Mǝ nǝ tasǝ mǝturonjar mem
ɓǝ̀ ako dǝmba,
mǝnana nǝ̀ gilǝkio njargula
sǝ a nǝ yiu ka.>
Ən nggǝ na wun, aɓalǝ aɓwana mǝnana kat à ɓǝlia a ɓanza man ngga, kǝɓwa pà kàm kútì Yohana nǝ gulo ɗang. Sǝama ɓwa mǝnana nda mǝkyauwe kat aɓata Domurǝm mala Ɓakuli ka ndanǝ gulo kútì.>>

content: Ɓwapǝndǝa kat, ko nggearǝ amǝ'ak boalo-cemi, lang à oangŋa cau mala Yesu ka, à ear kat ama, njargula mala Ɓakuli ka mǝɓoarne na, acemǝnana Yohana nǝ̀ pakkia wia batisǝma.
Sǝ amǝ Farisi andǝ amalǝm nggurcau ka à ginǝ kàné mala Ɓakuli mǝnana acea ka, acemǝnana à ɓinǝ ama ɓǝ̀ Yohana ɓǝ̀ kǝa pakkia wia batisǝma ɗàng.
Yesu lidǝmba nǝ cau ama:

content.text: Arǝ man sǝ mǝ nǝ kànì aɓwana mǝnana a nza man ngga? À nda kǝla mana?
À nda kǝla amuna mǝnana à do a kun limo, à kǝ akia rǝia cau ama:
Sǝm twangga wun ntetu,
sǝ wu ta'nggwam ɗang;
sǝm tuka wun nggyal ɓua-lú,
sǝ wu ɓua ɗàng!>>
Yohana Mǝbatisǝma ka yiu kǝ li nɗǝmo ɗàng, kǝ nu mùr-anap ɗàng. Sǝ wu na ama, <<Ndanǝ kukwar atè.>>
Muna mala Ɓwa yiu kǝ li, kǝ nu, nyare wu na ama, <<Wu sǝn nggea mǝ'lǐgula, mǝ nukiagir, gyajam mala amǝ'ak boalo-cemi andǝ <amǝ'cauɓikea.> >>
Kat andǝ amani ka sǝlǝe mala Ɓakuli ka, yi lǝmdǝ rǝì mǝsǝcau na aɓalǝ atúró mala aɓwana mǝnana à é ka.

content: Yesu a ɓala mala Shimanɓwa Farisi
Ɓè ɓwa aɓalǝ amǝ Farisi tunǝ Yesu arǝ girlina pwarikpǝra. Pǝlǝa Yesu wari a ɓala mala ɓwa Farisi man kya do aban li.

A là mǝno ka ɓè ɓwama nda kam mǝnana à súrǝì nǝ do aɓa cauɓikea, mā-gyatarǝu na ka. Lang ok ama Yesu nda ban li a ɓala mala ɓwa Farisi ka, yiu nǝ muna-dù mǝ'ɓoarjamnì mana à lumsǝì nǝ mùrú mǝ'rǝmɓoarne, mana kúrè candǝ ka.

Yiu yi kūndǝ nǝ ban akusǝ Yesu a nzǝmi, sǝ kǝ ɓua; liu anzǝm kusǝ Yesu nǝ mǝrǝm, esǝkia nǝ nyang múrí, sǝ kùria arǝì nǝ abui; camarǝ jeki akusǝ Yesu tùtù nǝ mburkuni, sǝ kǝ hasǝia nǝ mùrú mǝ'rǝmɓoarne.

Ɓwa Farisi mǝnana tunǝ Yesu arǝ girlina ka sǝn mǝnia ka. Pǝlǝa na nǝ ɓabumi ama, <<Ɓǝ̀ ɓwa man ngga mǝɓangnǝa mala Ɓakuli na ka, ɓǝ́ súrǝ́nà rǝ ɓwa mǝnana jekiyi rǝì, sǝ koya ulang ɓwama nda man ngga, acemǝnana mǝ'cauɓikea na.>>
Yesu eari wi ama,

content.text: <<Shiman, mǝ ndanǝ cau mǝnana mǝ nǝ no ka.>>

content: Pǝlǝa pe eare ama, <<Nam ce, Malǝm.>>
Yesu ne wi ama,

content.text: <<Ɓè ɓwa kǝ kpata aɓwana ɓari tangna. Ɓwa mwashat ka ak mǝsǝboalo gbǝman-tongno, sǝ ɓeɓwa ka lumi-tongno nda ak ka.
Yia kǝm ngga à gandǝ mbwe ka tangna man ɗang. Mǝpa-tangna pǝlǝa twalia wia ban mǝno yì atangna ka. Sǝ ado ka yana aɓalǝia nǝ̀ earce nǝ̀ kutibanì?>>

content: Shiman eari wi ama, <<A sǝne mem ngga ɓwa mǝnana tangna male kpǝm sǝ à twali wi banì ka.>> Yesu ne wi ama,

content.text: <<Yàwá! A nani pepè.>>

content: Pǝlǝa pǝlǝ rǝì a ban ɓwama man, sǝ ne Shiman ama,

content.text: <<A sǝn mǝnia yì ɓwama ka? Ən kutio a ɓala mo, a pam mur lákkí akusǝu ɗang. Sǝ ɓwama man ngga liupam akusǝam nǝ mǝrǝm male. Sǝ kǝ esǝkia nǝ nyang muri.
A gingsǝam nǝ nu kunam ɗàng, sǝ mǝnia yì ɓwama ka, kutio mem mǝni ɗār ka, ko aulǝa tù kúni arǝ nu ka kusǝam ɗàng.
A hasǝam mùrú a ɓamuram ɗàng, sǝ yì ka, hasǝam mùrú mǝ'rǝmɓoarne arǝ akusǝam.
Ace mani ka, ǝn nggǝ banggo, earcearǝu male mana gul kpǝm ngga, lǝmdǝ ama, acauɓikea mǝgule male ka à twalǝni wi bania kat. Sǝ ɓwa mǝnana à twali wi banì bǝti ka, earcearǝu male gbal ka nda bǝti.>>

content: Yesu pǝlǝa ne ɓwama mǝno ka ama,

content.text: <<À twalǝno ban acauɓikea mo.>>

content: Acili aɓwana mǝnana a ban li ka, a tita nea rǝia ama, <<Man yì ɓwa ka nda yana, mǝnana kǝ gandǝ twalban cauɓikea ka?>>
Pǝlǝa Yesu ne ɓwama mǝno ama,

content.text: <<Paɓamuru mô amsǝno; o atà dorǝpwala mô.>>

footnotes.text: Ɓalli gbal aɓa: Mat 26:7; Mar 14:3; Yoh 12:3.
